note: Vesti: Tactical Upgrade (slug vesti-tactical-upgrade, aka vtu/vestitu — variant of base vesti; never the bare base name, P0 disambiguation) — Elysion Fire RL Attacker, Burst III, 40s CD, ammo 8, reloadFrames 142, chargeFrames 120, chargeMultiplier 200, normalMult 22.44 / coreMult 200, critRate 15 / critDamage 150. FROM-SCRATCH kit-autonomy build 2026-08-01 (no prior override; baseline was bare weapon, simSupported:false). A full-charge RL carry whose damage lives in the 'Missile Guide' charge window and her true-damage riders/nuke. EVERY modelable line keys off landing Full Charge attacks = trigger shotFired (the per-trigger-pull trigger, routed through applyBlock so block gates are enforced). shotFired == 'when landing Full Charge attacks' for this unit because RL shots are ALWAYS charged (isCharge = RL && !swap), so every rocket she lands is a full charge. shotFired is chosen over the per-full-charge chargeCounter trigger deliberately: chargeCounter applies its effect via applyEffect DIRECTLY and therefore BYPASSES block-level gates (fbGate / requiresTargetStatus, checked only in applyBlock) — which the S2 'Battle Formation' (fbGate:'inFb') and 'Explosive Round' (requiresTargetStatus) lines REQUIRE (verified: a chargeCounter encoding fired those two lines ungated — 384 spurious projectileExplosionPct applications + out-of-FB ATK applications). Multi-effect lines are split into separate single-effect blocks. S1 MISSILE GUIDE ('when performing a Full Charge attack while not in Missile Guide status', self): two self buffs, each its own shotFired block — (S1a) Charge Speed ▲100% = chargeSpeedPct 100, (S1b) Charge Damage ▲58.5% = chargeDamagePct 58.5 — BOTH durationShots:3 ('for 3 round(s)' = round-count, holder-scoped, no wall-clock expiry; helm-burst durationShots precedent) + removeOnReload:true ('Removes Missile Guide upon reloading to max ammunition' — cinderella S1 toggle precedent; the buff ends at the EARLIER of 3 rounds fired OR a reload-to-max). The 'while not in Missile Guide status' re-trigger gate is NOT separately encoded (the engine has no 'not-currently-buffed' self gate) — and this is NOT damage-neutral: shotFired refreshes the 3-round window on every full charge, so the sim runs Missile Guide at near-permanent uptime while firing, whereas the true kit lapses MG after 3 rounds and re-grants only on the NEXT (un-buffed, full 120f) charge — a duty cycle the encoding over-credits (see ⚑5 / caveat 1). The durationShots:3 + removeOnReload structure is faithful; only the missing gate inflates uptime. S2 MONSTER STAGE ('when landing Full Charge attacks'): (S2a) every full charge → the target 266.6% of final ATK as TRUE damage = shotFired → enemy flatDamage 266.6 flavor 'true' (crit-eligible by the flatDamage default e.crit!==false, noRange rider convention; true damage CAN crit — owner ruling 2026-07-25); (S2b) 'if self is in Battle Formation status → self ATK ▲20% for 3 sec' is UNMODELED (verbatim in unmodeled.skill2) — 'Battle Formation' is a self-status NOTHING in this kit grants and the schema has no self-status gate (requiresTargetStatus is boss-scoped, requiresShielded is shields); the driver initially read it as fbGate:'inFb' (Battle Formation == Full Burst) but ADOPTED the blind consensus (S2b claude-fable-5 + S5 AND S6 claude-opus-5 ALL independently re-derived INERT/unmodeled): with no carrier the line never fires, and encoding it ungated would grant a near-permanent +20% ATK over-credit (see ⚑6); (S2c) 'if target is in Explosive Round status → self Projectile Explosion Damage ▲20% for 3 sec' = shotFired + requiresTargetStatus:'Explosive Round' → self projectileExplosionPct 20 / 3s. 'Explosive Round' is eunhwa-tactical-upgrade's burst-cannon status (the only other unit referencing it — a Tactical-Upgrade-sisters synergy); ETU currently models her Explosive Round as a boss damageTaken rider, NOT a named targetStatus, so NO in-scope unit opens a targetStatus:'Explosive Round' and this gate is INERT in current board comps (marciana/privaty/rem named-status-gate pattern — faithful structure, inert until a source opens the named status; caveat 2). BURST 'Missile Container Online' (burstCast): (BUa) self True Damage ▲60% for 10s = trueDamagePct 60 / 10s (Damage-Up bucket that pays off ONLY on true-flavored hits — her S2a 266.6% riders and the BUb nuke; ~5-10 full charges land in the 10s post-burst window with the charge instant under Missile Guide); (BUb) 'all enemies (incl. parts) 492.3% of final ATK as Burst Skill true damage' = burstCast → enemy flatDamage 492.3 flavor 'true' (single boss; burst bucket; noFb — a burstCast nuke lands BEFORE the Full Burst window opens so it never takes the +50% major, helm-H7/U10 convention). UNMODELED: burst 'Explosion Radius ▲100% for 10s' — inert vs the single partless scope-lock boss (splash radius moves no damage) and there is no explosion-radius stat; recorded verbatim. RESIDUAL ⚑ flags: ⚑1 Charge Speed ▲100% is encoded chargeSpeedPct 100, which the engine's SUBTRACTIVE-time convention (sim.ts needed = chargeFrames × (1 − cs/100)) reads as an INSTANT charge (cs=100 → 0 frames) rather than a literal ×2-speed/÷2-time; the kit magnitude (100) is pinned faithfully, the engine's interpretation of 100 is a global convention shared by every chargeSpeedPct carrier (red-hood/maxwell/mana), not a per-unit fudge. Estimate: if the true in-game cap is ÷2-time, her Missile-Guide fire cadence is over-credited; recipe: focus-video her charge period inside vs outside Missile Guide. ⚑2 the 'Explosive Round' gate (S2c) is inert until a unit opens targetStatus:'Explosive Round' (ETU models hers as damageTaken, not a named status); recipe: when ETU is reworked, emit a targetStatus:'Explosive Round' from her cannon so this gate goes live; Tier 2. ⚑3 the engine pre-pins vesti-tu's burst-gauge generation to FOCUS_CHARGE_GEN when focused (sim.ts PENDING_TEAM_ISOLATION) because her datamined fullChargeBonus 200 is unmeasured and the only 200-column measurement (cinderella) contradicts 2.0x — this is ENGINE-owned gauge cadence (not an override line), affects how fast she bursts, not her per-hit damage; recipe: a focused solo recording to pin her real charge-gen multiplier. ⚑4 RL cadence tuple (chargeFrames 120 / reloadFrames 142 / ammo 8) is datamined, not focus-verified for this unit; read rounds/min + reload gap from any focus video. ⚑5 the 'while not in Missile Guide' re-trigger gate is unexpressible (no 'not-currently-buffed' self gate); shotFired refreshes the durationShots:3 window every full charge → near-permanent MG uptime, OVER-crediting shot count vs the true duty cycle (periodic un-buffed 120f charges every ~4th); durationShots+removeOnReload structure faithful, only uptime inflated; recipe: focus-video the slow-charge recurrence; Tier 2. ⚑6 'Battle Formation' (S2b ATK ▲20% gate) is UNMODELED, adopting the blind consensus (S2b fable + S5/S6 opus all re-derived INERT): the gating self-status is granted nowhere in this kit and the schema has no self-status gate, so the line never fires in-scope. The driver's alternative reading — fbGate:'inFb' (Battle Formation == the Full Burst state; no roster granter references the name, consistent with a global state) — is retained as the measurement-gated alternative; if footage shows the ATK ▲20% proc tracking Full Burst windows, restore a shotFired + fbGate:'inFb' atkPct 20 / 3s block. Estimate: modeling it would add the FB-window ATK ▲20% (~few % of damage); recipe: focus-video whether the ATK ▲20% buff icon appears during Full Burst; Tier 2. NUKE ORDERING (verified): the BUb 492.3% nuke lands UNDER its own same-cast BUa trueDamagePct 60 (buff block precedes nuke block at burstCast; nuke mult.dmgUp 1.962 with the buff vs 1.362 without — the +0.60 is ADDITIVE in the Damage-Up bucket, not a ×1.60 multiplicative step). Tier 2 (round-count durationShots, status-gate requiresTargetStatus + fbGate, burstCast-vs-rider timing, true-flavor scoping). Kit-autonomy gauntlet 2026-08-01.
